canonical_example.translation: Much of my pay is eaten up by taxes!

canonical_example.translation: Ivan blew through his lottery winnings in a few months.

canonical_example.translation: We crashed into the garage door when we reversed.

canonical_example.text: Tengo una cita con doña Alicia Lago.
canonical_example.translation: I have an appointment with Mrs. Alicia Lago.

canonical_example.text: Ese gato está tan gordo que no alcanza saltar al sofá.
canonical_example.translation: That cat is so fat it can't jump onto the couch.

canonical_example.translation: Sumo wrestlers have to be overweight.

canonical_example.text: Tengo que leer un libro gordo para mi clase de historia.
canonical_example.translation: I have to read a thick book for my history class.

canonical_example.text: Te vas a meter en un lío gordo si sigues así.
canonical_example.translation: You're going to get yourself into big trouble if you keep carrying on like that.

canonical_example.text: Se burlaron de mí porque soy gordo.
canonical_example.translation: They made fun of me for being a fat person.

canonical_example.text: Quítale el gordo a la carne antes de meterla al sartén.

canonical_example.text: El chico gordo decidió ponerse en forma.
canonical_example.translation: The heavy boy decided to get in shape.

canonical_example.translation: My sister called me to tell me something serious happened to her in Mexico City.

canonical_example.text: Yo estaba sentado entre dos gordos.
canonical_example.translation: I was sitting between two fat men.

canonical_example.text: La gorda que tenía adelante caminaba más lento que yo.
canonical_example.translation: The fat woman in front of me walked more slowly than I.

canonical_example.text: Te ves muy bien, gordo.
canonical_example.translation: You look wonderful, dear.

canonical_example.text: Pues, como me gané el gordo, ¡voy a renunciar!
canonical_example.translation: Well, since I won the jackpot, I'm going to quit!

canonical_example.text: Necesito canela para la tarta.
canonical_example.translation: I need some cinnamon for the cake.

canonical_example.translation: You need to leave now if you want to make your flight.

canonical_example.translation: Confronted with their refusal to grant us funds, we were forced to go out and ask for donations.

canonical_example.translation: Amanda was relieved when she saw the pregnancy test was negative.

canonical_example.text: Tengo mala suerte, por eso soy negativo respecto de todo.
canonical_example.translation: I have bad luck, that's why I'm negative about everything.

canonical_example.text: El polo negativo de la pila está indicado con el símbolo "-".
canonical_example.translation: The negative pole of the battery is marked with a "-" sign.

canonical_example.text: Su negativa no sorprendió a nadie. Todos sabíamos que no se iba a declarar culpable.
canonical_example.translation: His denial didn't surprise anybody. We knew he wouldn't plead guilty.

canonical_example.text: Aprendimos a formular oraciones negativas e interrogativas.
canonical_example.translation: We learned how to construct negative and interrogative sentences.

canonical_example.text: Te olvidaste de añadir el signo negativo delante del número.
canonical_example.translation: You forgot to add the minus sign in front of the number.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cuál es el valor de y cuando x es equivalente a cinco negativo?
canonical_example.translation: What is the value of y when x is equal to negative five?

canonical_example.text: Todavía tengo que revelar los negativos de la fiesta de anoche.
canonical_example.translation: I still need to develop the negatives from last night's party.

canonical_example.text: Tráeme las llaves, por favor.
canonical_example.translation: Bring me the keys, please.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué traes en esta maleta tan pesada?
canonical_example.translation: What are you carrying in that heavy suitcase?

canonical_example.translation: The bride is wearing a long, white dress with delicate lace.

canonical_example.text: Este periódico no trae crucigrama.
canonical_example.translation: This newspaper doesn't have a crossword.

canonical_example.text: ¡Ese ruido me trae loco!
canonical_example.translation: That noise is driving me crazy!

canonical_example.text: Hizo una nueva amiga en el colegio.
canonical_example.translation: He made a new friend at school.

canonical_example.translation: He made her cry.

canonical_example.text: Hacía la casa sola.
canonical_example.translation: I thought there was nobody at home.

canonical_example.text: Haz lo que te digo.
canonical_example.translation: Do as I say.

canonical_example.translation: It took them two weeks to drive to California.

canonical_example.translation: Today felt really long waiting for my test results.

canonical_example.translation: That hairstyle makes you look older.

canonical_example.translation: Don't act the fool at school!

canonical_example.translation: They say the doctor makes at least six figures.

canonical_example.text: Mi hermanito hizo una fortuna vendiendo limonada.
canonical_example.translation: My little brother earned a fortune selling lemonade.

canonical_example.text: Hicimos 150 millas en el último viaje.
canonical_example.translation: We did 150 miles on the last vacation.

canonical_example.text: Podemos hacer más distancia si salimos de noche.
canonical_example.translation: We can cover more distance if we leave at night.

canonical_example.text: Hace mucho tiempo que no te veo.
canonical_example.translation: It has been a long time since I've seen you.

canonical_example.text: En invierno hace frío.
canonical_example.translation: It's cold in winter.

canonical_example.text: Se hizo un vestido de seda.
canonical_example.translation: She made herself a silk dress.

canonical_example.translation: I think I'm going to make myself some carrot soup tonight.

canonical_example.text: No te hagas el santo; tú también te equivocas.
canonical_example.translation: Don't pretend to be a saint; you make mistakes, too.

canonical_example.text: No te hagas el tonto conmigo.
canonical_example.translation: Don't act the fool with me.

canonical_example.text: Su sueño era hacerse dentista.
canonical_example.translation: His dream was to become a dentist.

canonical_example.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
canonical_example.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.
